capability: One clock: pause anywhere, see one clean picture
title: Every frame lives on the line.

hook.picture: Close on the whale beside the line, mid-explanation. It taps pause and the line freezes mid-wave; two half-faded cards overlap into a smear above it.
hook.words: Let me pause here and point.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: I paused it to explain, and the frame was mush.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: three replays of the same film stacked as ghost lines; each freezes at the same moment with the cards in different places.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Each play draws its own slightly different film.

stakes.body: A frame you cannot pause on is a frame you cannot teach from; screenshots, reviews and replays all disagree.

solution_hint: Draw each moment from the clock alone.

metaphor.body: The line is the clock. Each tick on it names one exact picture, so the whale can land on any tick, any number of times, and find the same frame.

steps.picture: Ticks drop along the line at even steps. The whale lands on one, and the frame above it draws cleanly, card by card.
steps.words: Draw each moment from the clock alone.

steps.picture: The whale hops back three ticks, then forward again; the frame above each tick is identical both times, and a ring flashes on each match.
steps.sound: Clean tick plus soft chime per match

steps.picture: Two cards try to light in the same spot; a small gate on the line closes; one card fades out before the other arrives.
The gate steps across the whole line, every tick, and glows; its name lands on its post.
steps.words: A machine checks every frame: a gate.
steps.sound: Tick run sweeping up the scale

real_case.claim: The ceti-explainer repo lists 15 shipped films, and one script rebuilds and gates every film and demo in about 10 minutes.

honest_limit.picture: Push into one clean frame: an arrow points the wrong way, drawn exactly the same on every replay, and the gate glows pass.
honest_limit.words: Wrong can be the same every time.

not_this.body: Same every time is not right.

ending_pattern.body: FELT framing returns. The whale taps pause at three random ticks in a row; each time the frame is clean and identical to its last visit. Spark.
ending_pattern.callback: The pause that smeared in bar 1 now lands, in the same framing, on one clean frame.

end_belief.body: Build films you can pause anywhere.

sound.problem_motif: The same tick smeared by a short, off-beat echo

score_self.reason: Problem and move read from pictures; the smear is a vivid felt pain. Risk: a phone viewer may not read "frame" as the teaching moment, and the CASE card number is about films, not pauses.
